item.title: Accidental fire causes $80,000 damage to Peoria home
item.description: A fire caused $80,000 in damage to a Peoria home under construction, with no injuries reported and the fire determined to be accidental.

item.title: More than 1,000 people take the plunge in Bloomington to support Special Olympics Illinois
item.description: Over 1,000 participants from across Central Illinois braved cold water to raise over $185,000 for the Special Olympics Illinois at the annual Law Enforcement Torch Run Polar Plunge.

item.title: Illinois leaders react to US, Israel attack on Iran
item.description: Illinois leaders have criticized President Trump's decision to launch an attack on Iran, citing the lack of justification, authorization from Congress, and potential consequences for American service members and regional stability.

item.title: Three US service members killed, five seriously wounded in Iran operation: Military
item.description: They are the first reported American casualties since the U.S. and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran.

item.title: Illinois needs to get 'much nastier,' coach says following loss to Michigan
item.description: CHAMPAIGN, Ill. (WMBD/WYZZ) -- Illinois can't win the Big Ten regular season championship any longer. But now the emphasis may be on figuring out its flaws before the Big Ten Tournament. Certainly, before the NCAA Tournament. Michigan clinched the Big Ten regular season crown with a convincing 84-70 win over Illinois in Champaign on Friday. [...]

item.title: Jack in the Box Office: 'Scream 7' scores franchise-best opening weekend with $64 million
item.description: Scream 7 debuted with a franchise-best $64 million, despite behind-the-scenes drama and mixed reviews, while Sony Animation's Goat and Warner Bros.' Wuthering Heights took second and third place respectively.

item.title: At least 22 people killed in Pakistan as protesters try to storm US Consulate
item.description: KARACHI, Pakistan (AP) — Violent clashes between protesters and security forces in Pakistan's southern port city of Karachi and in the country's north left at least 22 people dead and more than 120 others injured as demonstrators supportive of the Iranian government attempted to storm a U.S. Consulate on Sunday, authorities said. item.title: 'Indicators' of possible terrorism in deadly Austin mass shooting: FBI
item.description: Two people are dead and 14 more are injured after the early morning shooting. The alleged gunman was fatally shot by officers, according to authorities.
